paper_metadata.title: A 0.7-V MOSFET-Only Switched-Opamp Modulator in Standard Digital CMOS Technology
paper_metadata.abstract: A 0.7-V MOSFET-only modulator for voice band applications is presented. The second-order modulator is realized using a switched-opamp technique. All capacitors are realized using compensated MOS devices operated in the depletion region. A combination of parallel and series compensated depletion-mode MOSCAPs is used to obtain high area efficiency. The circuit is fabricated in a 0.18m CMOS process. The only components used are standard n-MOS and p-MOS transistors with threshold voltages of approximately 400 mV. All transistors Fig. 1.
